entries.german: König Rupertus erlaubt dem Cuncze von Rosenberg, Sohn des sel. Ritters Conrad von Rosenberg, weiland Vizthums von Amberg, und dem Conrad von Rosenberg, in ihrem Dorfe Hoenstat bei Rosenberg gelegen, Schultheiss, Schöffen und Gericht zu haben, C.
entries.english: King Ruprecht permits Kunz von Rosenberg (son of the late knight Konrad von Rosenberg, formerly Viztame of Amberg) and Konrad von Rosenberg, to have a reeve, aldermen, and a court in their village of Hohenstatt, situated near Rosenberg, C.
facts: Kunz von Rosenberg was the son of the deceased knight Konrad von Rosenberg, formerly Vizedom of Amberg.

King Ruprecht permitted Kunz von Rosenberg, son of Konrad von Rosenberg (formerly Vizedom of Amberg), and another Konrad von Rosenberg (whose father is not identified in the source) to have a Schultheiss, Schöffen, and court in their village of Hohenstadt near Rosenberg.
